ocr.notes: Gist readable but many garbled words, especially in the speech and the sparring paragraphs.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that a crowded Theater Comique saw Tom Allen's benefit, where he was introduced as champion of the world, ready to fight any man, and sparred tamely with Jack Madden.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Friday, September 26, 1873' with the masthead 'Daily Democrat' (before the May 1875 merger, so not yet the Globe-Democrat).

facts.fact: Allen took a benefit at the Theater Comique, St. Louis, sparring with Jack Madden, with Patsy Shepherd and Arthur Chambers also boxing; the house was crowded
At the benefit Allen wore the heavyweight championship belt and was introduced by manager Fred Wilson as champion of the world, ready and willing to fight any man in the world
